lines.en: : So basically, a few minutes ago, we were several years into the future, but...also still freshmen in high school because we’ve been caught in a time loop for an indeterminate amount of time.
: Are we roleplaying? Because it sounds like we’re roleplaying, but you guys both look super serious.
: So you really don’t remember any of that? No...Apocalypse Squad or...end-of-the-world slumber parties with Yumi, Noriko, and Sana?
: Wait, Yumi’s involved in this? And who the heck is Noriko? I’m going to need some background information if I’m going to play my role correctly, Makoto.
: Unbelievable...
: We really did go back several years then...
: But only you and me...why? How?

: I have no clue...but Ayane doesn’t seem to be interrupting us when we mention the state of the universe either, so...maybe she’s still...somehow privy to all of this? And just...doesn’t remember it?

: Wait...are you guys trying to say that this isn’t some kind of roleplay thing? That you, like...actually time-traveled here from several years in the future? When? And why didn’t you say anything until now?
: Because it literally just happened, Ayane. So did you notice either one of us acting...peculiar a few moments ago? Or anything else that seemed out of the ordinary today?
: I’m sorry for the barrage of questions, I just...this isn’t something I really have any idea how to approach. Especially when, to me, you were an entirely different person just a minute ago.
: You guys have seemed normal all day. Everyone has. But what was I like if I’m different from the way I am now?
: You were kind of the one leading the charge for all of this time stuff. Which is why both of us have no idea where to go from here as this was something we were entirely unprepared for.
: Wait, I was the leader? Why? I don’t know the first thing about time travel. Wouldn’t you be way more suited for something like that, Makoto?
: On a technical level, yes. But I placed my priorities elsewhere as you two were the ones who cared more about “fixing” things than I ever did.
: Ayane...what do you remember? What am I to you? What is Makoto to you?
: Well...Makoto is just Makoto, I guess. We don’t really talk much. And you’re my teacher.
: Just your teacher?
: That is a leading question that I refuse to answer in public.
: Do you have sex with him or not? Answer honestly, we’re in the information gathering phase here.
: D-Do I what?! Sensei and me?! W-What are you saying?!
: Just tell her, Ayane. It doesn’t need to be a secret in this timeline. Makoto already knows in the other one.
: Knows what?! W-W-We’ve never done anything even c...close to that before! Ami would kill me! And you’re...you...you don’t see me that way at all! Not even close!
: You two fuck like rabbits where we come from.
: We do?...
: You’re practically husband and wife.
: Why does this alternate reality sound so much better than mine?! I want to go to that one instead! Unless this is a joke and/or setup! If it is, just pretend I never said that!
: Was Ayane always this cute? Is this what happens in a world where she isn’t being constantly ravaged by you?
: That’s enough, Makoto. Ayane clearly doesn’t know anything. We’re not going to gain anything from questioning her. But maybe if we talk to Maya-
: Maya...
: She should still be here...
: You’re right! She was caught up in this stuff way before you and Ayane were, wasn’t she? Maybe she’ll have an idea of-
: Sorry to interrupt, but who are you talking about now?
: Maya. You know...the girl you and Ami are always hanging out with?
: Oh, you mean Sana. The one who sits in the back of class, right? I know she’s quiet, but I figured you two at least knew her name.
: Well, this certainly makes everything a lot more complicated all of a sudden.
: Hah...hahahah...
: S...Sensei? Is everything-
: Is everything okay?
: Oh! L...Looks like Ami’s here now! My job is done! Bye, guys! I promise I wasn’t hitting on him, Ami! They came up to me!
: Ignore her. What’s going on? Are you having a panic attack? Can I help?
: Ami...you remember Maya, don’t you?...
: Who? Is she a friend of yours or something?
: This...has quickly become a much worse scenario than I originally thought.
: Also, why are you hanging around Makoto? Didn’t I tell you she’s the kind of girl who will try to steal your bodily fluids and freeze them for later use? You should stay away from her.
: You really don’t remember, Ami?...
: No...but you know you can lean on me if you’re feeling lost and confused, right? I get how hard it is for you to remember stuff when you’re feeling overwhelmed.
: Did you at least take your pills today? I have some of them in my bag if you need any. Just let me know.
: Ami, could you give Sensei and me a minute alone? He’s going to slip into another state of catatonia at this-
: Sorry, who the heck do you think you are exactly? You don’t know the first thing about taking care of him, you obsessive, four-eyed loser. Why should I give you a minute with him at all?
: Sensei, surely you’ll stick up for me given the...circumstances, right?
: Bzzt. Looks like no one loves you after all. Please leave now.
How did this happen?...
Undoing all of my progress while stripping me of the one thing I’d hold onto if given a choice is a fate worse than death...
Do I need to die now? Is that the path I need to take to make things right again?
If I hang myself from the rafters for all to see, will I wake up in a world where she exists again?
Or will the next time I’m greeted by the glow of the sun pouring into a mostly-empty classroom feel just as lonely as this?
[[PAREIDOLIA DOES NOT EXIST. THERE IS NO ONE PRESENT TO PROVIDE COLOR COMMENTARY ON AKIRA ARAKAWA’S CURRENT THOUGHT PROCESS.]
Even the voice in my head has left me behind...
Now all I can do is rot somewhere else I’m not meant to be.

: Okay. Sorry, Ami. I...get what this probably looks like from your perspective. But if it’s not a problem, I’d like to maybe try and explain why Sensei is like this and...where we were just a moment ago.
: What are you talking about? You guys have been here for like four hours. And I know that for a fact since I’ve been keeping my eye on you the whole time!
: I’m sure that’s how it looks. But the truth is that Sensei and I...and please don’t mock me for saying this...were just teleported here from a different timeline.
: Oh, why didn’t you just say so? That makes perfect sense.
: It...It does?
: No, you friggin’ moron! How dumb do you think I am that I’d just buy that super crazy story?!
: I know how it sounds! That’s why I asked you not to mock me! But that’s seriously what happened!
: Oh, and I’m guessing there were also flying cars and hover-boards too?
: No! Just the occasional apocalypse and...an exponentially larger harem.
: Well, there’s no “harem” here. So I suggest you run along and bother somebody else so you’re not bothering my dad anymore.
: Honestly, Makoto — you’re lucky he hasn’t had you sent to another class yet with how much time you spend trying to get into his pants.
: He lets me into those pants willingly, you delusional red-headed freak!
: HA! As-if! Sensei has everything he could need and more already! You’re lucky he even gives you the time of day!
: And you’re lucky he hasn’t put you up for adoption yet with how unbearably annoying you are! Now stop trying to attach yourself to his hip and just listen to me for a second!
: You can talk as much as you want, Makoto! All I hear is “blah blah blah!” Oh! And another thing! You-
: She called me “Dad...”
: Huh?
: She was still my niece the last time we were here...
: She didn’t start calling me “Dad” until years later...
: Wait, yeah...why did you call him that?
: Hey, I only agreed to call him “Sensei” during school hours because I’d get in trouble if I didn’t! But these ain’t school hours, Makoto! I’m calling him “Dad” all night and you can’t stop me!
: But he’s your uncle.
: What? What are you talking about?
: He said just a second ago that you’re his niece. And while he may act like a father figure, the fact remains that you’ve somehow carried a late-stage development to an earlier time where-
: Dad, just tell her you misspoke. You know I’m your real daughter, right?
: Real...daughter?...
: Mhm! You’re probably just confused because you’re about to have another mental breakdown. Or you’ve got that Owzymer’s thingy or whatever it’s called. But you know who I really am, don’t you?
: Oh my god...
: You’re my...real daughter?...
: Sensei...uhh...
: How do I put this?...
: Of course, silly! Oh, and look! Here comes proof!
: Mom! Daddy is pretending I’m not his real daughter again!
: Aki-kuuuun. No hurting Ami’s feelings. She’s living through what is arguably the most impressionable part of her life, you know.
: ...Sekai?
: Wow. I haven’t heard you call me by my real name in years. It’s always “darling” or “baby.” Or “Mommy” after 10:00 PM and Ami is in bed.
: I’m going to pretend I didn’t just hear that.
: Sensei...I’m...going to go stand off to the side for a minute...
: You can come get me whenever you...yeah...
: Ugh! Finally. She’s acting super weird today and it was making me uncomfortable.
: Is something wrong with Makoto? She seems a little...shaken.
: It’s just...how she seems? I don’t really know how to describe it.
: No...how are you here? You’re dead.
: I am?!
: She is?!
: Yes! And all of this...all of this is because of you! What I am! Who I became! It’s all because of what you did to me! How you left me all alone!
: Jeez, Aki-kun. I just went to pick up some snacks for the girls. If I had known it’d be such an issue, I’d have brought you along with me.
: I think he’s having another one of his things, Mom. But he doesn’t want to take his medication. I already tried. It’s probably something Makoto said that triggered him.
: I’m sure he’ll snap out of it on his own, baby. It’s nothing you have to worry about. Now, go have fun with your friends. I’ll take care of your father.
: There’s really nothing I can do to help?
: You? Not right now.
: But if Makoto has an idea of what might have triggered this, I’d love to hear from her as to what might have happened. Could you grab her for me, baby?
: Ughhhh! Fine...
: Makoto! Can you come back over here for a second?! My mom needs you!
: I...have no idea what’s going on right now...
